channel.title: MyStat stable updates
channel.description: Stable releases for Apple Silicon on macOS 26 and 27.

item.title: MyStat 0.1.3
item.description:
MyStat 0.1.3
Fixes in-app update checks on macOS 27. The signed stable feed and local updater now accept macOS 26 and 27. Physical sensor support on macOS 27 remains experimental; VM testing does not validate hardware readings.
On macOS 26, use Check for Updates in MyStat 0.1.2 to install this release. Older MyStat builds already running on macOS 27 require one manual installation of 0.1.3 because their local OS restriction prevents checking. After that, Check for Updates works normally. Published 0.1.1 also requires a manual upgrade because it has no updater.
Automatic checks remain off by default. Opt-in checks notify you; installation still requires your action. Signed feeds and downloads, no telemetry, no system profiling, and no privileged helper. Install in a user-owned writable Applications folder.
Apple Silicon only. The app is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. Sparkle is bundled under its included license; MyStat remains MIT licensed. Substantial implementation and testing assistance from OpenAI Codex.
